name: healthy-home-api
description: Vercel serverless function. `resend` is declared here AND in the root package.json: the root copy is what lets `tsc -b` type-check api/send.ts during `npm run build`, because Vercel only runs the root `npm install`. Declaring it in both places does NOT put the SDK in the browser - nothing under api/ is reachable from src/, so Vite never bundles it.
